During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], there was a '''duel''' in [[Spaceport Nine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] between the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] and the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] turned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. The duel began when Sing nearly [[Death/Legends|killed]] one of Pavan's allies, a [[Gray Paladin]] named [[Laranth Tarak]]. After a brief [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber duel]], Pavan trapped Sing in a [[reposticator]] that was filled with sand, which Sing slowly sunk into.
